messages:
pagerbot: PAGER: sev=high - telemetry exporter flagged suspicious auth header values being forwarded to analytics-bucket. Oncall: mara. Please acknowledge.

mara: acknowledged. taking lead. seeing alerts for repeated `auth_header` field in kafka->s3 exporter.

mara: quick summary: CI telemetry exporter (kafka-exporter-prod) appears to have included `auth_header` in debug payloads for ~15m. Rate ~1.2k msgs/min. unknown if persisted externally beyond s3 staging.

jamal: do we have the s3 path & examples? can we stop the exporter quickly?

mara: yes - path: s3://redwood-telemetry-staging/exports/2026-03-18/stream-42/*. starting containment now.

mara: running stop on exporter: `kubectl -n infra scale deployment kafka-exporter-prod --replicas=0`

mara: `kubectl` output: deployment.apps/kafka-exporter-prod scaled

olivia (security): good. next: rotate any service tokens used by that exporter, revoke temporary creds, and block external IPs that were consuming the bucket. also need sample payloads for triage (redact before sharing outside sec).

jmal: (typo) jamal: I can rotate the CI runner token used by that job. which service account?

dylan (eng-infra): exporter uses svcacct `svc-telemetry-producer@infra`. token mount at `/var/run/secrets/k8s/telemetry-token`. CI runner also used a short-lived token derived from that SA.

dylan (eng-infra): found sample (redacted): ```{
  "event":"model_infer",
  "auth_header":"Bearer eyJhbGciOiJI...REDACTED...xyz",
  "user_id":"anon-123"
}```

dylan (eng-infra): sample saved to `/tmp/incident/3265432109/sample-1.json` on bastion.

olivia (security): confirmed: tokens present, no raw PII observed in quick scan. treat token exposure as credential compromise — rotate immediately and assume reuse.

legal: need timeline: earliest and latest known exposure times, list of customer tenants in affected payloads, and confirmation if any external partner buckets pulled this data. we may need to notify customers depending on scope.

mara: earliest observed 2026-03-18T09:12:10Z, stopped at 2026-03-18T09:27:40Z. jamal/dylan to confirm tenant mapping for payloads.

jamal: running quick grep on sample set to map tenants. `jq -r .tenant_id | sort | uniq -c`

jamal: results: tenant ids observed: tenant_alpha (1140 msgs), tenant_beta (37 msgs), tenant_internal (dev) (520 msgs).

olivia (security): customer impact: tenant_alpha and tenant_beta saw tokens in payloads. tenant_internal is infra test. recommend: immediate token rotation for tenant_alpha and tenant_beta service tokens, invalidate sessions for the small window, and enable additional rate-limits for exporter consumers.

dylan (eng-infra): rotating svcacct creds now: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete ... && gcloud iam service-accounts keys create ...` will push new key to KMS. also applying bucket ACL lockdown: `aws s3api put-bucket-policy --bucket redwood-telemetry-staging --policy file://tight-policy.json`

mara: actions being executed: - exporter scaled to 0 - svcacct keys rotated (dylan) - CI runner token rotation (jamal) - block consumer IPs at WAF (mara) - save sample artifacts to secure vault (olivia)

jamal: CI runner token rotated. posted new token to vault: `vault kv put secret/ci/telemetry token=...` (only ops have access).

mara: WAF blocked external IPs that were requesting the s3 exports: 3 IPs blocked, rules deployed.

legal: thx. please put a minimal fact timeline in #incidents with exact timestamps for our notification draft. we need to triage whether this is a reportable incident under our policy.

olivia (security): short note for timeline posted to /incidents/3265432109/timeline.md (internal link). no confirmed exfil beyond staging bucket, but assume worst case for tokens. recommend notifying tenant_alpha and tenant_beta with recommended mitigations (rotate keys, audit sessions).

sre-rotations: recommend automated sweep to rotate ephemeral tokens every 30m for affected service account while we investigate root cause. scheduling job now.

jamal: assigned follow-ups: @dylan rotate any remaining keys, @mara continue blocking rules and watch for replays, @olivia lead customer notification draft, @legal review.

mara: holding oncall until handoff in 2 hrs. next: deep root-cause (why exporter included `auth_header`) + postmortem.

olivia (security): immediate root cause hypothesis: debug flag leakage in exporter codepath (`include_headers: true` toggled during a debug deploy). check recent deploys to kafka-exporter-prod.

dylan (eng-infra): checked deploys: a canary 2026-03-18T08:55 toggled `INCLUDE_HEADERS=true` in configmap; rollback applied 09:05 but exporter continued streaming until we scaled down. will capture diff and PR.

mara: thanks everyone. containment complete for now. we'll stand up a bridge if anything reappears. postmortem owner: jamal.

mara: closing thread for live ops; will update incident doc with timeline, actions, customer notifications, and link to postmortem in 48h.
